name: The Art of the Armorsmith

angles.text: Crafting these ornate mithril pieces proves your dedication to the anvil and opens the path to becoming an Armorsmith.

aliases: who gives the art of the armorsmith
faq.answer: Grumnus requires the armor to prove your skill before training you as an Armorsmith.
faq.q: Who asks for these ornate mithril pieces?

aliases: the art of the armorsmith requirements
faq.answer: You need to forge four Ornate Mithril Helms, two pairs of Ornate Mithril Boots, and one Ornate Mithril Breastplate.
faq.q: What armor pieces must you forge for Grumnus?

aliases: purpose of the art of the armorsmith
faq.answer: He requires proof of your forging craft before he will recognize you as an Armorsmith.
faq.q: Why does Grumnus want this armor?

sections.body: Grumnus demands tangible evidence of your craftsmanship before he recognizes you as a true Armorsmith. To satisfy him, you must hammer out four ornate mithril helms, two pairs of ornate mithril boots, and a finished ornate mithril breastplate at your forge. Only presenting this fine mithril panoply will earn his instruction in the trade.
sections.title: Mastery of Mithril

summary: Grumnus requires proof of your metalworking skill before granting you the title of Armorsmith. You must forge several ornate mithril armors to show your mastery at the anvil.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Art of the Armorsmith
